meta.note: bulletins[] lists the bulletin types each station airs; dated bulletin text is generated by scripts/tableslop/radio-bulletins.js into bulletins.json. stream_status: verified = curl-checked audio/* on 2026-08-05; none = lore-only, player shows static.

stations.name: The Dream
stations.theme: Exotica and resort-lounge for the hotel strip — tiki instrumentals, lobby covers of salsa records, nothing a buffet line couldn't keep up with.
stations.flavor: Beach weather, cruise arrivals, gala social notes. Will not say the word 'incident'.
stations.stream_note: SomaFM Tiki Time — classic tiki / vintage island rhythms. Verified 2026-08-05: HTTP 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg.

stations.name: La Dura
stations.theme: Salsa dura and bolero out of the Porto warehouses — Fania-era hard salsa, son cubano, bolero after midnight.
stations.flavor: Port report, union notices, Carnaval committee minutes in full. Owned by nobody, which is why the docks trust it.
stations.stream_note: No off-island relay. Static between stations.

stations.name: The Quay
stations.theme: EDM out of the Quay — house and trance overnight, Quay Nights simulcasts, vaporwave in the hungover hours.
stations.flavor: Club calendar and the blotter: a sanitized police log read absolutely straight. Never says 'Tithe'.
stations.stream_note: SomaFM The Trip — house / trance / dance. Verified 2026-08-05: HTTP 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg.

stations.name: The Hum
stations.city: Island-wide (transmitter lease: a Ledger Row shell)
stations.theme: Late-night talk radio where every caller has a theory about the Dry Contract. Drone and static-adjacent bumper beds.
stations.flavor: One topic of the night, exhausted by 3:30. Coral Trace keeps a seven-second tape delay; count it.
stations.stream_note: SomaFM SF 10-33 — ambient mixed with live public-safety scanner traffic; the closest off-island thing to the Hum's signal. Verified 2026-08-05: HTTP 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg.

stations.name: Radio Sierra
stations.theme: The federal voice — big-band swing and American standards from the postwar migration wave, orchestral Sundays.
stations.flavor: Straight news, the island's only straight news. Has never reported on the humidity.
stations.stream_note: WQXR New York public classical — carries the federal voice's orchestral/standards side; no reliable HTTPS swing relay exists (Swiss Jazz verified audio/mpeg but redirects to plain-HTTP nodes = mixed-content dead on the production HTTPS mount). Verified 2026-08-05: HTTPS 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg.

stations.name: The Harbor
stations.theme: Boat radio — son cubano oldies and AM gold, the records the harbor's parents danced to.
stations.flavor: Sea conditions, tides, lost-and-found (one engine, one ring, one goat), church-hall calendar.
stations.stream_note: Range limited by the antenna on Old Man Reyes' roof. Static between stations.
